usage.callShape: POST https://blockrun.ai/api/v1/chat/completions with JSON body {model, messages[]} (OpenAI chat-completions compatible)
usage.outputShape: body.choices[0].message.content (assistant text); token usage at body.usage.total_tokens
quirks: model id must be 'google/gemini-3.5-flash' (despite the product being branded 'Gemini 3 Flash')
price varies with token usage; this minimal hello call cost ~$0.0026
usage.guide: Standard OpenAI-compatible chat completions endpoint paid per-call via x402 on Base. POST a JSON body with model set to "google/gemini-3.5-flash" and a messages array of {role, content} objects. Read the assistant reply at body.choices[0].message.content. Synchronous, no auth beyond x402 payment, no polling. Cost scales with token usage.
